assertion_notes: Full matrix: 24 fresh trials, 12 conditions repeated twice.
The strengthened 8 fresh committed-contact trials exclude neutral reconciliation replay from the actual committed-response count; motion rows record replay and committed_integration independently.

Body correction is measured before current prediction integration, after authoritative snap and neutral replay. The driver requires nonzero correction; a perfectly predicted baseline defender can have zero corrections.
Each client independently requires nonempty replay and convergence to a reliable settled authoritative sample within 0.01 m for ten consecutive observations.
Moving stale snapshot distances are not treated as same-tick server/client error; phase/frame equality and exact historical committed replay are not claimed.
